title: Claude Code pre-tool-use permissions
description: Policy file for the tool-permissions hook. Files are evaluated as an ordered source list, most-important first: $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/permissions.local.json, then $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/permissions.json, then $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/permissions.json (global). The first source with any matching rule decides the call (full override); within a source the order is allow > ask > deny > default, independent of regex length. Only 'version' is required — a file may set any subset of allow/deny/ask.

bucket.description: Map of tool name (or '|'-joined file-tool group) → array of regex patterns. Empty array [] matches unconditionally. File tools (Read/Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit) may be grouped with '|'; non-file tools (Bash/WebSearch/WebFetch/Skill) must appear alone.

propertyNames.description: Tool name. Use WebFetch (not Fetch — the hook normalises the UI alias at runtime). File tools may be '|'-joined to share a pattern list; all other tools must appear alone.

patternList.description: List of ECMAScript regex patterns matched against the tool's input field. Empty list [] matches the tool unconditionally regardless of input.

items.description: ECMAScript regex. ~/  expands to $HOME at runtime. Match target per tool: Bash→command, Read/Edit/MultiEdit/Write→file_path, NotebookEdit→notebook_path, WebSearch→query, WebFetch→url, Skill→skill.
